name: implement
description: Build TALXIS / Power Platform / Dataverse apps in a local-first monorepo. Describe an app and /implement:builder scaffolds it end to end — data model, backend logic, frontend, security, tests — or reach for one concern at a time. Thin skills that steer the agent to the TALXIS CLI (txc) for everything, and deploy only when asked. Use when creating a new TALXIS project or working on an existing one.
